title: t a6olf h1tler script MADE BY V0C0N
script:
-- Player References
local Player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local Backpack = Player.Backpack
local Character = Player.Character or Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local Humanoid = Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

-- Notification Function
local function SendNotification(Title, Text, Duration)
    game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = Title;
        Text = Text;
        Duration = Duration;
    })
end

SendNotification("made by V0C0N", "my scripts always good :3", 10)

-- Tool Creation
local Tool = Instance.new("Tool")
Tool.Parent = Backpack
Tool.Name = "ad3lf hjtler"
Tool.CanBeDropped = false
Tool.RequiresHandle = false
Tool.ToolTip = "14/88"

-- Animation Setup
local AnimationInstance = Instance.new("Animation")
AnimationInstance.Parent = Character
AnimationInstance.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://176236333" -- Direct ID format

local AnimationTrack = Humanoid:LoadAnimation(AnimationInstance)

-- Tool Functions
Tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
    if AnimationTrack then
        AnimationTrack:Play()
        AnimationTrack:AdjustSpeed(0)
        AnimationTrack.TimePosition = 0.1
    end
end)

Tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
    if AnimationTrack then
        AnimationTrack:Stop()
    end
end)
